questions.label: MCQ1
questions.question:
A box is pulled across a rough horizontal surface at a CONSTANT VELOCITY by a force F applied at an angle theta to the horizontal. Consider the following statements: (i) The net work done on the box is zero. (ii) The work done by the applied force F is equal to the work done by friction. (iii) The kinetic energy of the box increases. (iv) The mechanical energy of the box remains constant. Which of the statements above are CORRECT?

A (i) and (ii) only
B (i) and (iii) only
C (ii) and (iv) only
D (iii) and (iv) only

(2)

questions.label: MCQ2
questions.question:
A crane lifts a load vertically upwards at a CONSTANT SPEED. Which ONE of the following statements is CORRECT?

A The net work done on the load is zero.
B The work done by the crane on the load is zero.
C The kinetic energy of the load increases.
D The gravitational potential energy of the load decreases.

(2)

questions.label: MCQ3
questions.question:

Which of the statements above are CORRECT?

A (i) and (ii) only
B (i) and (iii) only
C (ii) and (iv) only
D (iii) and (iv) only

(2)

C Rate of work done by motor: Constant; Mechanical energy of bucket: Remains constant
D Rate of work done by motor: Increases; Mechanical energy of bucket: Remains constant

(2)
